The card's "same save path as column width and order, everyone using the view sees it" does not hold on main: width and order are per-user list state (`listPrefs.patchView`), and toolbar controls never write a shared view (shared views are written only from the view settings panel, draft then publish per ADR-0034). repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Ruling record · 2026-11-20T17:00Z · The maintainer answered the seat's decision card on 2026-11-20 at 17:00:26Z.

Question, verbatim: 「列表底部计算行：共享视图上选了计算，什么时候让别人看到？」
Options: 「先存草稿，发布后生效」 (a personal view: applies at once; a shared view: picked by someone allowed to edit the view, they see it at once, others see it after 「发布」, the same as an edit in the view settings panel, undoable) · 「选了立即对所有人生效」 (a shared view changes for everyone at once, bypassing draft and publish) · 「只存自己，再点保存进视图」 (per-user state like column width, shown as 「已个性化」, saved into the view only on save).
Answer, verbatim: 「先存草稿，发布后生效」.

So for #35702: a personal view writes the column `summary` at once; a shared view writes it as a draft through the same draft/publish path as the view settings panel (ADR-0034), visible to the editor at once and to others after publish; the toolbar rule "toolbar controls never write a shared view directly" stays. Acceptance "another user opening the same view sees it" holds after publish. Users without edit rights on the view see results and get no menu.
